# Third-party files in this folder

Each licence text is in `licenses/` (Poppins: in `fonts/`), copied from the package's own published licence file.

- manifold-3d 3.2.1 (manifold.js, manifold.wasm, manifold-api.d.ts) — Apache-2.0 — `licenses/manifold-3d-LICENSE.txt` — https://github.com/elalish/manifold
- three 0.170.0 (three.module.js, OrbitControls.js) — MIT — `licenses/three-LICENSE.txt` — https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
- opentype.js 1.3.4 (opentype.module.js) — MIT — `licenses/opentype.js-LICENSE.txt` — https://github.com/opentypejs/opentype.js
- Poppins Bold — SIL Open Font License 1.1 — `fonts/Poppins-OFL.txt` — https://github.com/itfoundry/Poppins
- Noto Sans Bold — SIL Open Font License 1.1 — `licenses/NotoSans-OFL.txt` — https://github.com/notofonts/latin-greek-cyrillic
